about: R3-EARTH-LINK EL3b.3 (design r3/earth-link.md EL3b): how Earth's feed looks at each Earth rate. The band is chosen by earth.rate (D) alone: the first band whose min <= D (and D < max, when max is given). Nothing is computed from D: the feed's speed is the sim's earth.feed frame moving with the newest light, and the band only styles it. jumble 0..1: ghosts of the weeks that flicked past; drift: a near-still frame breathes slowly; tint: the Doppler shift as a stylized warm (receding) or cool (approaching) wash, an indicator and not a spectral render (gate 2 asserts the bands at RS-26..RS-29 in tests/test_physics.gd); whirl: Earth's clock hand blurs. Calibrated on the RS values: 7.0711e-4 (top speed, astern) still, 0.070888 (0.99c astern) slow, 1 real, 14.107 (0.99c ahead) fast, 1414.2 (top speed, ahead) torrent.
